data.body: **[P2] Make shutdown actually terminate or await running work.** `cancel_futures=True` only cancels queued futures; running `ThreadPoolExecutor` calls continue, and Python waits for these worker threads before process exit. Closing a runner during a blocked chained invoke can therefore keep the process alive until the read timeout, or indefinitely for an in-process handler. Use a killable/daemonized execution mechanism, close active clients, or explicitly await running work with a bounded shutdown policy.
